system.description:
A long, hooded cloak made of an advanced metallic polymer, embedded with pigment-shifting nanoparticles. A kinetic battery is mounted in the clasp. The cloak is large enough that it can cover a person’s entire body. When active, the cloak shifts color to blend in with the surroundings, absorbs the wearer’s body heat, and diffuses and refracts active sensors.

A Covert Cloak adds +1 success to the wearer’s Skill Tests in an opposed Test when an enemy is searching for them, and it allows a character to hide even without any other available cover or concealment. A covert cloak is a powered device, which recharges after a Break rest.
